import re
s=open('.local/seven-smart-2026-10-20/editor-api-tests.log').read();r=re.findall(r'test result: (\w+)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored',s);print({'suites':len(r),'passed':sum(int(x[1])for x in r),'failed':sum(int(x[2])for x in r),'ignored':sum(int(x[3])for x in r)})
PY
